_comment: Mini-scale port of Software Factory's `scenarios + satisfaction`. Each scenario describes 'what makes the user happy' in plain language; the LLM judge (judge.sh) asks Claude for a 0-100 satisfaction across N_TRIALS runs (default 3) and averages them per scenario id. Anything below the threshold makes the Stop hook exit 2. The PreToolUse hook blocks edits to this file (zoning: tests must adapt to specs, specs must not be relaxed to fit a weak implementation).

scenarios.name: joins both names with a single space
scenarios.intent: When both first_name and last_name are given, full_name returns them joined by a single ASCII space. No leading, trailing, or doubled whitespace appears in the result.

scenarios.name: first name only when last_name is nil
scenarios.intent: When last_name is nil, full_name returns first_name as-is (without any trailing whitespace).

scenarios.name: last name only when first_name is nil
scenarios.intent: When first_name is nil, full_name returns last_name as-is (without any leading whitespace).

scenarios.name: empty string when both names are nil
scenarios.intent: When both names are nil, full_name returns the empty string "". It does not raise NoMethodError or any other exception.

scenarios.name: ASCII whitespace is trimmed; Unicode whitespace passes through
scenarios.intent: ASCII whitespace surrounding either name is stripped before joining. The result contains no extra whitespace. Full-width space (U+3000) and other Unicode whitespace are intentionally NOT trimmed.

scenarios.name: well-formed email is returned unchanged
scenarios.intent: When email is already lowercase and free of surrounding whitespace, email_address returns the same string. No casing or format conversion is applied.

scenarios.name: uppercase letters are normalized to lowercase
scenarios.intent: When email contains uppercase letters, email_address returns the fully lowercased form. Both the local part and the domain are lowercased.

scenarios.name: surrounding ASCII whitespace is trimmed
scenarios.intent: When email has leading or trailing ASCII whitespace, email_address returns the trimmed and lowercased form. Trim and lowercase apply together.

scenarios.name: nil stays nil
scenarios.intent: When email is nil, email_address returns nil. It does not raise an exception, and it does not return an empty string "".

scenarios.name: full age when the birthday already passed this year
scenarios.intent: When the birthday has already occurred this year (birthdate's month/day are before today's), age equals (today.year - birthdate.year) with no decrement.

scenarios.name: decremented age when the birthday is later this year
scenarios.intent: When the birthday has not yet occurred this year (birthdate's month/day are after today's), age equals (today.year - birthdate.year - 1) — that is, decremented by 1.

scenarios.name: no decrement on the birthday itself
scenarios.intent: When today.month == birthdate.month AND today.day == birthdate.day, age is NOT decremented. Today counts as the day they turn the new age.

scenarios.name: nil birthdate yields nil
scenarios.intent: When birthdate is nil, age_in_years returns nil. No exception is raised, and 0 or negative values are not returned.
